title: Director at Systems Integrator Sees Databricks Gaining Enterprise Share Amid Strong Growth and Expanding AI Adoption
expert: Director, global systems integrator and Databricks partner serving large enterprises (current)
verdict: This global SI's Databricks practice grew 24%-26% in Q3 with deal sizes 25%-30% larger and Lakebase/SQL warehouse prices up 12%-14%, and it expects 28%-30% in Q4 as Databricks wins share in enterprise deals.
